**Updating seek callbacks**

I’m setting up the seek functionality so that when a seek starts, I’ll set a flag to true and calculate the start time plus duration. I’ll call `onSeekPreviewStart` with the necessary parameters. The requirement states that feedback must clear after the gesture, so I'll ensure to call this method at the end, even without duration. I’ll also update the HeroFeedbackSurface constructor to accept optional callbacks, setting defaults to null to avoid issues with existing tests.

Throughout, I'll make sure to call the appropriate callbacks at the right time for seamless UI updates.
